title: Ollivier's Ricci Curvature on Complex-weighted Graphs
summary: Understanding the geometry of complex networks is critical for effective modeling and analysis across domains. While discrete notions of Ricci curvature have emerged as powerful tools for characterizing both local and global network structure, existing formulations are largely confined to undirected networks with real-valued weights. This limits the use of curvature-based analysis of directional and complex-weighted relations that arise naturally in many applications, from social and biological systems to quantum and signal-processing networks.
